_comment: Maps the state/country that ESPN's box-score location string ends with to our fixed 20-slot region label. Matching is done via string-EndsWith, so multi-word city names (e.g. 'Clarendon Hills Illinois') still resolve correctly off the trailing state/country name. Any location that doesn't end with one of these keys is reported as UNRESOLVED by fetch-scores.ps1 rather than guessed.
_openSlots: These 4 international regions are multi-country pools. The actual qualifying country isn't known until early-to-mid August, right before the LLWS starts. Once the 2026 qualifiers conclude, add an entry here mapping that country's name (as ESPN will print it) to the region label, e.g. "Venezuela": "LATIN AMERICA". Until then, any team from these regions will show up as UNRESOLVED when the script runs.
